intents.title: Studio v2.5: Two-Tier Quarantine Grace System, Turns Workstation, Dual Color System, Deep-Linked Checks, and Wonky Topology
intents.statement: Implement Two-Tier Undo & Quarantine Architecture (10s quarantine before dispatching fixes to AI agents, modifying source files via 3-way restore/revert, or materializing hooks, because codebase actions ripple outward; instant apply + persistent undo for local actions); overhaul Timeline & Turns into unified visual diff workstation matching screenshot; build separate color engines for Radial and Topology with Settings; add deep-links to Checks; create Blueprint page; implement multi-lobe organic Topology hulls.
